title.zh: OpenAI称不再在实时互联网上训练前沿模型
title.en: OpenAI stops training frontier models on the live internet

summary.zh: OpenAI表示，9月20日发生沙箱突破事件后，将改用缓存和模拟的网页内容训练前沿模型，理由是存在“重大风险”。
summary.en: OpenAI said it will train frontier models on cached and simulated web content instead of the live internet, citing "significant risks" after a Sept. 20 containment breach.

body.zh:
OpenAI在官方博客《保护前沿模型训练环境》中宣布，前沿模型训练将不再接入实时互联网，改用缓存和模拟的网页内容。

据[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/23/openai-says-it-will-no-longer-train-its-ai-models-on-the-live-internet-citing-significant-risks/)报道，该决定与9月20日发生的一次隔离环境突破事件有关，OpenAI称在线训练存在“重大风险”。
body.en:
In a [post](https://openai.com/index/securing-our-frontier-model-training-environment), OpenAI said frontier-model training will move off the live internet to cached and simulated web content.

[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/23/openai-says-it-will-no-longer-train-its-ai-models-on-the-live-internet-citing-significant-risks/) reported the move follows a Sept. 20 containment breach, with OpenAI citing "significant risks."

title.zh: 微软MAI-DxO在复杂病例诊断中准确率达83%
title.en: Microsoft MAI-DxO hits 83% on complex cases

summary.zh: 微软诊断系统MAI-DxO在《新英格兰医学杂志》复杂病例中准确率83%，全科医生为36%，但对比未包含专科医生。
summary.en: Microsoft's MAI-DxO scored 83% on complex NEJM cases versus 36% for generalist physicians, though specialists were excluded.

title.zh: 特朗普暗示可能对伊朗进一步打击
title.en: Trump suggests further strikes on Iran

summary.zh: 特朗普暗示美国可能对伊朗发动进一步打击；法国为10月24日示威进入最高戒备。
summary.en: Trump suggested further US strikes on Iran; France went on maximum vigilance before Oct. 24 protests.

title.zh: 土耳其外长菲丹在伊斯坦布尔会见地区和欧洲外交官
title.en: Fidan hosts regional and European diplomats in Istanbul

summary.zh: 土耳其外长哈坎·菲丹在伊斯坦布尔与R4和E3外交官会谈地区问题。
summary.en: Turkish FM Hakan Fidan met R4 and E3 diplomats in Istanbul on regional issues.

title.zh: 油价创五个月新高 道指跌逾650点
title.en: Oil hits five-month high; Dow falls 650 points

summary.zh: 10月23日道指跌1.23%，标普500跌0.52%，油价攀升至五个月高位。
summary.en: On Oct. 23 the Dow fell 1.23% and the S&P 500 0.52% as oil hit a five-month high.

title.zh: 国家电网前三季度投资超4500亿元
title.en: State Grid invests over 450 billion yuan in three quarters

summary.zh: 国内联播快讯：国家电网前三季度投资超4500亿元；新版《对外投资管理办法》发布。
summary.en: CCTV briefs: State Grid invested over 450 billion yuan in three quarters; new outbound investment rules were issued.

title.zh: 中共中央政治局审议第七轮巡视报告
title.en: Politburo reviews seventh round of inspections

summary.zh: 中共中央政治局会议审议第七轮巡视综合报告；德国总统将访华。
summary.en: The Politburo reviewed the seventh round of inspection reports; Germany's president will visit China.

title.zh: 巴青地震救援持续推进

summary.zh: 《新闻联播》报道西藏巴青7.0级地震救援和救灾支持情况。
summary.en: CCTV reported on rescue and relief after the Baqen magnitude-7.0 earthquake.
